fields.System.Title: Apply a coupon at checkout
fields.System.Description: As a customer I want to apply a coupon code in my cart so that I pay less.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
Scenario: Valid coupon reduces the total
Given a signed-in customer with items worth more than 2000 in the cart
When they apply the coupon FLAT500
Then the cart total is reduced by 500
And the coupon is shown as applied

Scenario: Expired coupon is rejected
Given a signed-in customer with items in the cart
When they apply an expired coupon
Then an error message is shown
And the total does not change

Scenario: Minimum order value
Given a cart worth less than the coupon minimum
When they apply the coupon FLAT500
Then the coupon is not applied and the minimum amount is shown
